comparators: Independent trits: lambda=(p-2k-4)/3^k for ordinary half-period runs; void exp(-lambda), second factorial moment lambda^2. Negligible all-monochrome correction omitted. The echo comparator is exact in the finite affine-root independent-trit model; source spans crossing a fold are not subtracted in the aggregate comparator (negligible O(k/p) fraction).
limits: Existing frozen million, including the512 diagnostics: no independent validation, universal Poisson theorem, refit or alteration of closed primary study.
uncertainty: SRS mean standard errors by each fixed stratum; finite-population correction omitted conservatively. Intervals and class contrasts are descriptive after exploration; no new p-values or fitted coefficients.
